integrity: The primary open PDF was inspected at Eqs. (2)-(4), the hazard plots and interpretation, Eq. (6), Eqs. (9)-(10), and publication/MSC metadata. The continuous PITL source and the earlier discrete inverted Topp-Leone source were checked as background. The correction follows by telescoping the source's PMF and was independently replayed in the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects printed survival, hazard, PGF, and first-moment formulas; it does not reconstruct unpublished software used for every numerical result.
Only the first raw-moment correction is quantified explicitly; higher PGF-derived moments also require reindexing.
PMF-based estimation formulas are not automatically invalidated by the survival-indexing error.
title: The DPITL survival and hazard are shifted by one lattice step
